translation: Chorus:
You alone are my everything, You alone are my foundation,
O Jesus, O Jesus, my heart’s surrender is Yours alone!
Verse 1:
More than Your blessings, my thirst is for You!
More than Your gifts, my thirst is for You!
More than Your works, my thirst is for You!
More than Your healings, my thirst is for You!
I desire nothing else besides You, I desire nothing else besides You.
Verse 2:
As the deer pants for streams of water,
So my soul pants for You, O Lord.
I desire nothing else besides You, I desire nothing else besides You.
Verse 3:
If Your presence does not go with me, I cannot leave this place, Lord.
Please reveal Your glory to me,
I desire nothing else besides Your grace, I desire nothing else besides Your grace.
Verse 4:
One thing I have asked of the Lord, that I may gaze upon His face,
And meditate upon Him in His temple.
I desire nothing else besides You, I desire nothing else besides You.
intro: Neekai Naa Thrushna is the latest Telugu Christian song written, tuned & sung by Dr. Asher Andrew. This song was released on July 19, 2026, through Dr. Asher Andrew YouTube Channel.
